dashboard.label: LeRobot SO-101 Agent
dashboard.description: SO-101 agent runtime: audio wake-word, policy inference (GR00T/scripted), arm telemetry — all via Splunk HEC

search.query: index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry (event_type=audio_event OR event_type=instruction OR event_type=policy_step) | transaction trigger_id maxspan=60s | search event_count>=2 | eval e2e_s=round(duration, 2) | timechart span=10m avg(e2e_s) as avg_e2e p95(e2e_s) as p95_e2e max(e2e_s) as max_e2e

index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry (event_type=audio_event OR event_type=instruction OR event_type=policy_step) | transaction trigger_id maxspan=60s | search event_count>=2 | eval latency_s=coalesce(round(inference_latency_ms/1000, 2), round(duration, 2)) | table _time trigger_id event_count duration policy_backend raw_message | sort -_time | head 10
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=audio_event stage=wake_word | stats count
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=policy_step | stats count avg(inference_latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms by policy_backend task_instruction | sort -count

index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=policy_step inference_latency_ms=* | timechart span=10m perc95(inference_latency_ms) as p95 avg(inference_latency_ms) as avg by policy_backend

chart.title: Commanded Action Dim 0 vs 1 by Instruction

search.query: index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=policy_step | eval a0=mvindex(commanded_action, 0), a1=mvindex(commanded_action, 1) | timechart span=10s avg(a0) as "dim0" avg(a1) as "dim1" by task_instruction

index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=robot_step | spath path=robot.joint_positions | table _time robot.joint_positions.shoulder_pan robot.joint_positions.shoulder_lift robot.joint_positions.elbow_flex robot.joint_positions.wrist_flex robot.joint_positions.wrist_roll robot.joint_positions.gripper | sort -_time | head 1

index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=robot_step | spath path=robot.joint_violations{} | search robot.joint_violations{}.position=* | table _time episode step robot.joint_violations{}.position robot.joint_violations{}.min robot.joint_violations{}.max | sort -_time | head 20
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=robot_step | spath path=robot.gripper_position | table _time robot.gripper_position | sort -_time | head 1
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=system_stats | timechart span=1m avg(cpu_percent) as CPU avg(ram_percent) as RAM
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry event_type=system_stats | timechart span=1m avg(process_cpu_percent) as agent_cpu avg(process_mem_mb) as agent_mem_mb
index=lerobot_telemetry sourcetype=lerobot:telemetry earliest=-15m | fields _time event_type raw_message trigger_id | sort -_time
